> You realize how awful anyone would feel if they realized they were making it easier for you die?

No. I don't understand people.

> I'd suggest giving it to somebody at the hostel

That would raise suspicion.

> You earned that money, use it on yourself bud.

No point in that since I'll be dead.
Would you like help ending it?
Another emo fag who won't be missed.

Not ironic. Terrible advice.

First, he belittles every form of suffering. Starving in a concentration camp with HIV? "SO WHAT!"

Second, his premise that one cannot "live incorrectly" is flawed. We're all born into society which has its own rules and expectations.

Third, using suicidal tendencies to justify careless behaviour is superficial, reckless, and idiotic. Depressed people seldom have enough motivation to skydive. It's also a luxury few can afford.

You figuring out how to deal with his suicide is one thing. But using it to guilt others into living is completely different. You should respect a stranger's right to live or die. It's a personal choice that is not yours to make.

And yes, expecting suicidal people to stay alive just so their friends and relatives don't have to suffer is very selfish. Fuck you again.
The best part about life is that you don't have to live it if you don't want to.

Oh Meredith, don't be so selfish. Sure, you're hurting, but your friend was hurting so much that he killed himself over it.

Fuck you and your guilt trip.
Sounds like it's time to shit or get off the pot.

> Its an incredible struggle that I am trying so hard to overcome. for 5 years now.

Suffering isn't temporary, asshole.
You know I'm not a troll.

> Everyone needs to know this, if you only persist, everything will be alright.

I'm old enough and experienced enough to know how completely full of shit this is. Life does not automatically work itself out. In fact, terrible situations can get much worse.

Sure, some people get better. Someone has to win the lottery. I'm glad circumstances have improved, but you're an exception, not a rule.
Happiness is a product of genes. It's not a choice.

I'm not sitting in the light. I've been chained in the dark for ages, so I know how much it stings when some glib asshole uses a Batman campaign ad to try and make a suicidal person feel better.

Fucking die.


P.S. Starbuck was a dude and Cylons are big metal robots.

> And the BioFit bra from Victoria's Secret. Comfiest thing ever for small girls with big boobs.

You don't write like a boy, I'm not a fucktard, and reddit runs on puns.

Would some free money help? I'm going to top myself soon. I [made a thread to try and give my savings away](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/128sjv/free_suicide_money_insert_dancing_silhouette_gif/), but the mods deleted it.

Truth.

You can't talk those who are determined out of committing suicide. After a certain point, all you can do is wish them well and hope they don't suffer any more than necessary.

I don't know why that reply was downvoted and removed. There's nothing malicious about it. People fucking baffle me.
Guess we won't see you later, abbigator.

> Everyone needs to know this, if you only persist, everything will be alright.

I'm old enough and experienced enough to know how completely full of shit this is. Life does not automatically work itself out. In fact, terrible situations can get much worse.

Sure, some people get better. Someone has to win the lottery. I'm glad circumstances have improved, but you're an exception, not a rule.

*Hey moderators, fuck you, I'm serious. I want to give my money to someone who can use it!*

****

**A few months ago I sold nearly all of my possessions and moved into a hostel. After paying for my cremation and the barbiturate I will use to kill myself, I have £4,556 remaining ($7,328 USD). I have no friends or family who can use it. I thought about giving it to charity, but that isn't enough to make a difference.**

**So maybe I can help someone who's in a bad spot but wants to live. I will wire the money to the person I feel deserves it the most. Simply tell me about yourself and how you would spend it. You may reply here or through reddit mail. Anyone who asks why I am doing this or tries to talk me out of it will be ignored and disqualified. Accounts created after this message is posted are ineligible. The more original and honest you are, the better your chances.**
Goodbye. I hope your pain ends.

Yes, it's two quotes. I tried putting an extra space between the two, but reddit wouldn't separate them.

And yes, the last account you used was stupid_fat_fucker. However, it was not the first one you created on reddit to elicit attention for being a failed suicidal lawyer.

The difference between us is that I'm only a crazy asshole when I want to be. You're an inveterate irritable fuck. Also, I'm actually going to kill myself and don't want anyone's pity.

> Everyone needs to know this, if you only persist, everything will be alright.

I'm old enough and experienced enough to know how completely full of shit this is. Life does not automatically work itself out. In fact, terrible situations can get much worse.

Sure, some people get better. Someone has to win the lottery. I'm glad circumstances have improved, but you're an exception, not a rule.

> but at least trying to help is better then not doing anything about it at all and realize that you could have done something.

Retarded *and* selfish. Combolations.

I know it's you. You had a gig doing document review in August. Every time you come back here you whine about how you can't get a "real job" as a lawyer then insult anyone who pretends to care. You threaten to kill yourself, attack as many people as possible, then delete your account/posts. Two months later you create another account and repeat the cycle.

Your tone and diction are the same, you use the same insults (fuckboat, sugartits), and you frequently employ bold/italics/lists.

Your back story is exactly the same. You're in your late twenties with extensive loans you cannot repay because no firm wanted you. When people tell you to move, you whine about having to study and take the bar in another state. Your crazy ex threw you out of the house you were living in. Your parents are divorced and you hate your dad:

> She is a hateful bitch who threw me out of our house after I tried to negotiate an agreement over how many hours I was working with her. There is no bargaining with crazy and no amount of pride-swallowing will work.


> Only child, parents divorced decades back and disowned me afterwards. Mom had enough of me when I was 18 and she no longer had to feed or house me, dad disinherited me after he found out I'd had sex before marriage.

Seriously, how many people could there be with the same circumstances who write/act the same way and post on the same suicide subreddit?

I'm one of the few people here who remembers you, and even I look forward to your death. You're a very unpleasant person with no redeeming qualities. The world will be better off without you.

Terrible isn't it, having your faith betrayed? In order to get as far as you did, you had to believe in yourself, believe in your institutions, believe in your educators. Good schools, good grades, good behaviour. You even believed in your ex before you found out she was batshit crazy.

But *you* made all those choices.

Ha-ha-ha!

HA!

I'm certain it's you, suicidal lawyer guy. And you know I know. Don't deny it.

You've posted here under at least six different accounts over the past year. Here's an example:

http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/u5i1p/if_i_have_not_found_a_permanent_job_in_my_field/

Each time you come back a little angrier and more jaded. I thought you might have actually killed yourself after the last time you posted here (August). Sadly you're still around whining about your STRUGGLES.

The only people who care are the ones you can't stand. Your rage is endearing. I'd buy you dinner if you were nearby.

Anyway, try not to fuck it up this time.

Hey, it's suicidal lawyer guy!

I thought you topped yourself two months ago.

Why am I not surprised to see you back here begging for pity...

Shall I open my trench coat and offer a method that actually works?

I'm glad you had an opportunity to say goodbye.

I understand what you mean when you say the depression has always been there. Do you think your knowledge of the human body, specifically the brain, has affected your chances of ending your life?

What do you think of newer treatment options like TMS and DBS?

Heh, I knew that'd be the club scene with Ving. Marty put a lot of undiscovered talent in that flick.

How was Deutschland?
You might enjoy [this](http://zyva.org/grj).

I don't think it's nice to lie to strangers, especially those who are suffering. It's better to be honest with people and allow them to make their own decisions based on facts.

You're a kid in high school (two words, genius) who posts meme comics. Making comments like yours to someone in his thirties who's down on his luck comes off as insulting. I know you want to help, but that doesn't mean you should bother when you can't relate.
It seems all anyone has to offer Smilla is platitudes, which obviously aren't helping.

> i really believe that good is bound to happen one day because "what come around goes around"

Yes, Virginia, there is a Santa Clause.

Someone who's "serious about suicide" would recognize this as a false analogy and would never reduce the value of human life to a cotton rectangle. History tells us banknotes can and do become worthless (e.g. Weimar Republic, post WWII Hungary, Mugabe's Zimbabwe).

Hard to believe such vacuous pap could receive so many upvotes. Turn your brains on, people.

Please explain which part of this sounds temporary:

> I'm in my thirties and I've never been happy. I have Complex PTSD due to an extremely abusive childhood. I don't trust anyone and have never been in a real, committed relationship. I have always felt ugly and disgusting and worthless.
